propositions: Implemented tickets must pass a plan-review gate at close time when require_plan_review_for_close=true, verifying signature and plan material validity without blocking on code freshness.

The close gate uses PlanValidityProfile.CLOSE which accepts certified reviews despite HEAD and per-file dependency drift but rejects unsigned, reopened, stale registry, material drift, malformed metadata, and phase incompatibility.
Pin drift/missing/malformed blocks only when enforce_plan_material_pins=true; all other validity checks always block regardless of pin enforcement setting.
The gate executes inside the existing transaction lock as a pre_status_check callback after structural checks but before STATUS append, catching changes between precheck and commit.

Bugs, session logs, code reviews, identities, and idea→closed transitions retain their existing exemptions; non-empty force-close reason bypasses both gates without bypassing structural child closure.
Failure returns exact verdict-prefixed message with separate review-plan remediation; unexpected exceptions fail closed as unavailable; close invokes zero LLM/model/network calls.
